value: name origin story told with a short, plain, first-person aside
text: Bombas explains its own name through the bumblebee origin story and adds the short aside We like that.

evidence.quote: The word Bombas is derived from the Latin word for bumblebee. Bees work together to make the hive a better place. We like that.
